turns.responseText:
CRO Submission Export — WuXi AppTec (BCR-ABL1 Campaign) — Validates cardiac safety, computes physicochemical properties, and formats all 5 ranked compounds into a WuXi-ready CSV export.

Input: 5 compounds with SMILES, campaign ranking (Asciminib #1 → Gleevec-analog-1 #5), IC50 (nM), hERG IC50 (μM), and composite scores from the BCR-ABL1 assay campaign
Key steps:

hERG safety gate (RDKit + assay data) → flag any compound with hERG IC50 ≤ 1 μM as cardiac-unsafe / excluded
WuXi column formatter (RDKit MW/LogP + assay merge) → structured submission table with compound_id, SMILES, IC50_nM, hERG_IC50_uM, MW, LogP, composite_score
CSV export validator → wuxiapptec_submission.csv + metadata JSON confirming all 5 compounds passed safety gate


Expected output: wuxiapptec_submission.csv (WuXi AppTec-formatted, 5 compounds, ranked by composite score) + submission_metadata.json (campaign ID, export timestamp, safety-gate summary)

Decision gate: Any compound with hERG IC50 ≤ 1 μM is automatically excluded from the export — all 5 must clear this threshold before the CSV is finalized.
Required inputs

Input data files (e.g., structures/SMILES, assay data, or concentration-time table)
Basic study metadata (condition, units, and endpoint definitions)

Next step

Confirm the intended analysis priority and upload the required inputs so I can produce a runnable, decision-ready workflow.
